title: RIA 개설은 어느 증권사가 좋을까? 증권사 이벤트 비교 2026년 4월

official_context_checks.statement: RIA stands for Reshoring Investment Account/국내시장복귀계좌; differs from ISA
official_context_checks.qualification: Law §91-26 and original March2026 broker instructions; portfolio from proceeds of specified existing foreign stock

official_context_checks.statement: 2025-12-23 cutoff refers to eligible shares held by end of the date
official_context_checks.qualification: Min(holdings 2025-12-23, holdings at transfer) matters; purchased only after Dec23 ineligible generally

official_context_checks.statement: RIA overseas stock sell proceeds are automatically converted to KRW on settlement
official_context_checks.qualification: Account cannot accept arbitrary cash deposits; eligible foreign stock must be transferred into RIA then sold

official_context_checks.statement: 1 person aggregate 50 million KRW RIA foreign stock settlement amount limit across all brokerages
official_context_checks.qualification: Many accounts allowed at multiple brokers, each one account per broker, but combined sale proceeds limit still 50m. Gross transfer stock market value not itself cap

official_context_checks.statement: 2026 foreign stock settlement by May31 100% income deduction rate, June-July80%, Aug-Dec50%
official_context_checks.qualification: The qualifying percentage is based on settlement/automatic FX date, NOT opening date or order date and not a 100% cash tax rebate. Ended 100% band before Oct

official_context_checks.statement: An RIA must retain 1y from LAST eligible settlement and hold KRW cash/allowed Korean equities or domestic equity funds
official_context_checks.qualification: If foreign stocks are sold at different dates, last eligible FX funding date controls final date

official_context_checks.statement: Withdrawing protected principal early (even partial) can invalidate full RIA benefit
official_context_checks.qualification: Broker's product disclosure distinguishes early protected principal withdrawal from withdrawals of growth exceeding invested principal, and listed legal unavoidable hardship exception

official_context_checks.statement: RIA allowed domestic products include KRX listed equities/qualified Korean equity ETFs or idle KRW cash
official_context_checks.qualification: Not all domestic listed ETFs count; domestic-listed US exposure normally is overseas investment substitute and may trigger penalty if held outside RIA

official_context_checks.statement: Buying foreign stocks and overseas-investing local ETFs in OTHER accounts in 2026 can reduce RIA relief
official_context_checks.qualification: Penalty net buying in all institutions including ISA/IRP, based on deal settlement and weighted Jan-May100%, Jun-Jul80%, Aug-Dec50%

official_context_checks.statement: For 2026 investment tax, RIA relief is calculated after gains netting and a separate 2.5m KRW overseas capital gain standard deduction
official_context_checks.qualification: Broker illustrates deduction ordering gains-losses, 2.5m KRW, RIA relief, then taxable remainder22% total. Individual actual gain is unverified

official_context_checks.statement: RIA domestic stocks market losses/FX changes can exceed event rewards and tax savings
official_context_checks.qualification: Issuer prospectus warns principal loss; foreign assets sale timing / currency FX are actual investment risks, not all investment outcomes profit

official_context_checks.statement: RIA is not the same as regular ISA and moving ISA balances is not an RIA tax-relief substitute
official_context_checks.qualification: RIA targets foreign-stock disposal tax with unique cutoff, timing and 1y lock; ISA imposes different taxable-income settlement

official_context_checks.statement: Mirae RIA promotion 2026-03-23 through 2026-05-31
official_context_checks.qualification: Original official promotion is archived/expired as-of Oct2026; as-of Apr15 this promotion existed

official_context_checks.statement: Mirae official promo awarded KRW10k to max33,000 customers subject to requirements
official_context_checks.qualification: RIA opening with Mirae account-specific limit at least 10m KRW, foreign stock transfer at least 1m KRW, event application. First30000 + lottery3000. Conditions maintained to campaign end; separate receiving CMA/stock account required

official_context_checks.statement: Mirae promotion lottery 2026 people selected among eligible customers
official_context_checks.qualification: Required foreign stock sale within RIA and Korean stock purchase at least KRW1m; separate awards lottery; could not treat 2026 all customers as guaranteed reward

official_context_checks.statement: Korea Investment offered RIA by March20, 2026
official_context_checks.qualification: Original first-party dated issuance details confirmed, NOT a historical dated April event cash reward table

official_context_checks.statement: Shinhan Investment launched RIA 2026-03-23
official_context_checks.qualification: Shinhan group April report notes launch; no April specific reward amount validated

official_context_checks.statement: KB RIA ETF net-buy promotional event announced Apr30 for May4-May31, AFTER video was recorded Apr15
official_context_checks.qualification: Must not backdate/post-hoc attach this event to speaker's Apr15 comparison

official_context_checks.statement: Kiwoom promo Apr24-Jul23 found, but for domestic BONDS, NOT RIA
official_context_checks.qualification: Search keyword mismatch; do not use as primary evidence of a Kiwoom RIA event
